LESSON: WRITING 6.4.1 CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.4: Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we be coherent and logical in our writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
